title: Andhra University withdraws disciplinary notices to six student leaders after protests

ai.summary: Andhra University withdrew disciplinary notices from six student leaders after student organisations protested, with the university advising them to follow procedures and submit representations.

facts.claim: Andhra University has withdrawn the notices issued to six student leaders following protests by student organisations.
facts.quote: Andhra University has withdrawn the notices issued to six student leaders following protests by student organisations.

facts.claim: In a communication on Tuesday, the university Registrar said that the notices, issued on October 31, 2026, on charges of indiscipline, stood withdrawn.
facts.quote: In a communication on Tuesday, the university Registrar said that the notices, issued on October 31, 2026, on charges of indiscipline, stood withdrawn.

facts.claim: The letters were issued to students from the departments of Political Science and Public Administration, Chemistry and Electronics and Communication Engineering, and Dr. B.R. Ambedkar College of Law.
facts.quote: The letters were issued to students from the departments of Political Science and Public Administration, Chemistry and Electronics and Communication Engineering, and Dr. B.R. Ambedkar College of Law.

facts.claim: The Registrar advised the students to follow university procedures and submit representations to chief wardens, principals, and other officials.
facts.quote: The Registrar advised the students to follow university procedures and submit representations to chief wardens, principals, and other officials.

facts.claim: The university further added that grievance sessions were held on the first and 15th of every month.
facts.quote: The university further added that grievance sessions were held on the first and 15th of every month.

facts.claim: The Students’ Federation of India (SFI), All India Students’ Federation (AISF), Progressive Democratic Students Organisation (PDSO) and All India Democratic Students Organisation (AIDSO) welcomed the decision, describing it as a victory for their united struggle.
facts.quote: The Students’ Federation of India (SFI), All India Students’ Federation (AISF), Progressive Democratic Students Organisation (PDSO) and All India Democratic Students Organisation (AIDSO) welcomed the decision, describing it as a victory for their united struggle.
